scientific_integrity: The finite checks corroborate but do not prove the infinite assertion; the full PF problem for each input is already treated by Cabanillas 2019. The asserted contribution is the uniform extremal type-spectrum rigidity.
scientific_limitations: Requires coprime generators at least 2p+1 and units modulo p; only the upper type range is classified. An unindexed equivalent high-type corollary remains possible.
title: Rigidity and a forbidden near-maximal type for two-generator numerical-semigroup quotients
